newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police destroy huge heroin plant.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police destroy huge heroin plant.

text.p: Colombia's elite anti-drug police on Wednesday destroyed the biggest heroin processing complex ever found in the country in a guerrilla stronghold in the southwest, authorities said.
Four laboratories were destroyed and precursor chemicals were seized along with 19 lbs (8.5 kg) of heroin, which police chiefs said would have fetched $680,000 in the United States.
"This was the biggest complex for heroin production that we have ever discovered in Colombia," deputy police chief Gen. Luis Enrique Montenegro said.

A helicopter, flying members of the anti-narcotics division's crack "search block" into the area near Santander de Quilichao, in Cauca province, came under fire during the operation and was forced to make an emergency landing.

At least seven people were arrested, and police battled for eight hours against suspected leftist rebels of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) close to the clandestine drug laboratories in the remote mountain region, police sources said.

The Colombian government, and more recently U.S. anti- drug officials, have highlighted the close links between drug traffickers and leftist guerrilla movements. They say the FARC, the country's largest and oldest guerrilla force, specialises in protecting illicit drug plantations and clandestine laboratories, a charge its spokesmen deny.

According to a report published last month by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration, Colombia has edged out Asia as the main supplier of heroin, of exceptionally high purity, to the United States. The DEA estimates Colombia supplies about 80 percent of the world's cocaine.

Until now, Colombia's fight against cocaine appears to have taken a higher priority than that against heroin. The National Police aims to destroy 10,000 acres (4,000 hectares) of illicit opium poppy plantations this year in its U.S.-backed drug crop eradication programme.

Earlier this week three clandestine cocaine laboratories were found and destroyed in eastern Guaviare province. And in separate developments on Wednesday, police seized three light aircraft that they said were being used for drug flights out of eastern Meta and Casanare provinces.
